mainText:
Good afternoon. Weather in Prishtina: 15 degrees now, light rain. Next 24 hours: high 15, low 3.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said attacks on the Crimean bridge are fully legitimate and Ukraine will never recognize Russia's annexation of the peninsula.

Bitcoin fell to its lowest level in two years, and US stock markets also saw a sharp drop, raising concerns among investors about a broader market correction.

Police in Kosovo have opened an investigation after a worker was found dead on a fish farm in Istog.

The Kosovo Ministry of Finance announced that citizens can register government bonds paying 4.6% interest until December 1, with a minimum purchase of 10,000 denars.

Recent Golden Boot winners Rodri, Ousmane Dembélé and Harry Kane all suffered serious injuries shortly after receiving the award.
